column1: # Custom 4MB partition table for the OnAir sign.
# The stock "Default 4MB with spiffs" scheme wastes 1.5MB on a SPIFFS
# filesystem this firmware never uses (config lives in NVS/Preferences
# the web UI is compiled into flash). That left only ~1.28MB per OTA app
# slot — the firmware was sitting at 99%.
# This layout reclaims the unused SPIFFS into the two OTA app slots:
# dropping usage to ~64%. A tiny SPIFFS remains only to satisfy tools.
# NOTE: a partition-table change cannot be delivered over OTA — it alters
# the flash layout. Existing devices need a one-time USB re-flash; new
